description: MemoryBackend::send_mdns checks dnt_address.is_none() then calls dnt_address.unwrap() on the next line. Clippy flags this as clippy::manual_let_else (or clippy::unwrap_used depending on config). Idiomatic Rust: 'let Some(dnt_address) = dnt_address else { not_sent.insert(...); continue; };'. Note: JMAP-77p9 already tracks this at P3 — the rusty pass re-scores it as P2 because clippy would catch it in CI. Fix: replace the is_none()/unwrap() pattern with let-else.
title: dnt_address.is_none() + unwrap() in MemoryBackend send_mdns (clippy::manual_let_else)
